name: Télé API
description: Endpoints for the Télé Android TV player, open to standard users: channels with the current program in one call, free provider connections, and the playback sessions of the caller.
author: Télé

fields.label: Endpoints
fields.description: Served under /api/tele/v1/ with the API key of any standard user. Each user only sees their own channels and sessions.

fields.label: Let players close their own sessions
fields.help_text: Télé closes the preview or the stream it left open before opening another one, so it does not hold two provider connections.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Checks that the /api/tele/ routes are installed in this worker.
